Detention_Center_Start.text: {bg:DetentionCenter}{fg:Detention_Bars}{center}{color:lime}{blip:3}{showTextbox}November 21st - Some time{nl}Detention Center{color:white}{p:800}

Detention_Center_Start.name: Phoenix
Detention_Center_Start.text: {blip:0,true}{color:white}Mareka!

Detention_Center_Start.name: Mareka
Detention_Center_Start.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Desi["Sweating"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter:400}{startBGM:detentionCenter,true}{showTextbox}{blip:2}Phoenix!{nl}I've been waiting for you!

Detention_Center_Start.name: Phoenix
Detention_Center_Start.text: {blip:0,false}This is quite a situation...

Detention_Center_Start.name: Mareka
Detention_Center_Start.text: {sprite:Desi["Normal"]}{blip:2}I know, right?{nl}What's going on with all this?

Detention_Center_Start.name: Mareka
Detention_Center_Start.text: {sprite:Desi["Thinking"]}Do you remember Yusaku?

Detention_Center_Start.name: Phoenix
Detention_Center_Start.text: {blip:0,true}{color:white}Yes, of course.

Detention_Center_Start.name: Phoenix
Detention_Center_Start.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(He was so timid... completely opposite of Mareka)

Detention_Center_Start.name: Mareka
Detention_Center_Start.text: {sprite:Desi["Normal"]}{blip:2}Well, Yusaku came to visit just a while ago...{nl}but he was so upset...

Detention_Center_Start.name: Mareka
Detention_Center_Start.text: He lost consciousness on his way home and ended up in the hospital...

Detention_Center_Start.name: Phoenix
Detention_Center_Start.text: {blip:0,true}{color:white}What?! Is he okay?

Detention_Center_Start.name: Mareka
Detention_Center_Start.text: {sprite:Desi["Sweating"]}{blip:2}Yeah, it wasn't anything serious they said... but still...

Detention_Center_Start.name: Phoenix
Detention_Center_Start.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(Poor Yusaku...)

Detention_Center_Start.name: Phoenix
Detention_Center_Start.text: {blip:0,true}{color:white}Wait a minute, Mareka. When did you become an actress?

Detention_Center_Start.name: Mareka
Detention_Center_Start.text: {sprite:Desi["Smiling"]}{blip:2}Oh, well... it's a long story.{nl}But Phoenix, help me out here!

Detention_Center_Start.name: Mareka
Detention_Center_Start.text: {sprite:Desi["Thinking"]}I know I love the thrill of things,{nl}I still can't stop speeding on my bike, and my spending habits haven't improved.

Detention_Center_Start.name: Mareka
Detention_Center_Start.text: {sprite:Desi["SmilingWide"]}But if I was going to kill someone, I'd do it out in the open!

Detention_Center_Start.name: Mareka
Detention_Center_Start.text: {sprite:Desi["Thinking"]}I'd never do something cowardly like making it look like an accident!

Detention_Center_Start.name: Phoenix
Detention_Center_Start.text: {blip:0,true}{color:white}I know that. That's why I'm{nl}going to prove your innocence with all my might. Tell me everything!

Detention_Center_Start.name: Mareka
Detention_Center_Start.text: {sprite:Desi["Smiling"]}{blip:2}Okay. Ask me anything!

Detention_Center_Start.name: Phoenix
Detention_Center_Start.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(Alright, what should I ask about...){color:white}{setAction:talk,true}{topicUnlock:Detention_Incident}{topicUnlock:Detention_Don}{topicUnlock:Detention_Yumi}{topicUnlock:Detention_Outfit}{setState:detention_intro_done,true}{sectionEnd}

Talk_Detention_Incident_Intro.name: Mareka
Talk_Detention_Incident_Intro.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Desi["Thinking"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{showEvidenceIcon:left,Yumi}{blip:2}I was rehearsing the scene where I{nl}hit Yumi with a vase.

Talk_Detention_Incident_Intro.name: Mareka
Talk_Detention_Incident_Intro.text: But it wasn't a real vase, it was a prop.{nl}It had glow-in-the-dark paint on it so you could see it even in the dark.

Talk_Detention_Incident_Intro.name: Mareka
Talk_Detention_Incident_Intro.text: {sprite:Desi["Sweating"]}I raised it just like the script said, and Yumi{nl}guarded with her left arm like always. But today,{nl}blood came pouring from her head.

Talk_Detention_Incident_Intro.name: Mareka
Talk_Detention_Incident_Intro.text: I called for an ambulance by hooking my harness{nl}to a wire and climbing out of the cage.

Talk_Detention_Incident_Intro.name: Mareka
Talk_Detention_Incident_Intro.text: I turned on the lights in the venue, called from the locker room,{nl}waited for the ambulance at the entrance... and when I came back, she was dead.

Talk_Detention_Incident_Intro.name: Phoenix
Talk_Detention_Incident_Intro.text: {hideEvidenceIcon}{blip:0,true}{color:white}Yes, I understand.{nl}Is there anything else that seemed odd?

Talk_Detention_Incident_Intro.name: Mareka
Talk_Detention_Incident_Intro.text: {sprite:Desi["Thinking"]}{blip:2}But the thing is, her body was found{nl}right next to the cage.

Talk_Detention_Incident_Intro.name: Mareka
Talk_Detention_Incident_Intro.text: Since the cage is part of the costume,{nl}she would never take it off.

Talk_Detention_Incident_Intro.name: Phoenix
Talk_Detention_Incident_Intro.text: {color:lightblue}{blip:0,false}(I've got the gist of her testimony.{nl}Time to look for contradictions){color:white}{setState:talked_detention_incident,true}{jump:Talk_Detention_Check}{sectionEnd}

Talk_Detention_Incident_Repeat.name: Mareka
Talk_Detention_Incident_Repeat.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Desi["Normal"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{blip:2}I'm telling you, I just called the ambulance.{nl}That's the truth.{sectionEnd}

Talk_Detention_Don_Intro.name: Mareka
Talk_Detention_Don_Intro.text: {sprite:Desi["SmilingWide"]}He said I hit Yumi on the head,{nl}but I hit her on the arm!

Talk_Detention_Don_Intro.name: Mareka
Talk_Detention_Don_Intro.text: {sprite:Desi["Thinking"]}Actually, I've had a dream about becoming an actress{nl}since I was young. I was in a small theater group.

Talk_Detention_Don_Intro.name: Mareka
Talk_Detention_Don_Intro.text: Don was strong back then, smart, confident, ambitious...

Talk_Detention_Don_Intro.name: Mareka
Talk_Detention_Don_Intro.text: And he came to me and said, 'I'll inherit the talent agency.{nl}Let's take over the world together.'

Talk_Detention_Don_Intro.name: Mareka
Talk_Detention_Don_Intro.text: {sprite:Desi["Thinking"]}{blip:2}Yeah. He charmed all the big shots in the industry{nl}and made them all like his servants.

Talk_Detention_Don_Intro.name: Mareka
Talk_Detention_Don_Intro.text: DON-ISM kept expanding its operations{nl}and bought up all kinds of entertainment facilities.

Talk_Detention_Don_Intro.name: Mareka
Talk_Detention_Don_Intro.text: {sprite:Desi["Thinking"]}He used to say 'The only thing I want now is Joypolis!'.

Talk_Detention_Don_Intro.name: Mareka
Talk_Detention_Don_Intro.text: But Yumi, who was an executive at Joypolis,{nl}seemed opposed to Don becoming the owner...

Talk_Detention_Don_Intro.name: Phoenix
Talk_Detention_Don_Intro.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(So there was that kind of conflict)

Talk_Detention_Don_Intro.name: Phoenix
Talk_Detention_Don_Intro.text: {color:lightblue}(Conflict between the victim and Don...{nl}This is important for establishing motive){color:white}{setState:talked_detention_don,true}{jump:Talk_Detention_Check}{sectionEnd}

Talk_Detention_Don_Repeat.name: Mareka
Talk_Detention_Don_Repeat.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Desi["Normal"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{blip:2}I'm grateful to Don.{nl}That's why I can't believe his testimony.{sectionEnd}

Talk_Detention_Yumi_Intro.name: Mareka
Talk_Detention_Yumi_Intro.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Desi["Sweating"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{blip:2}As you know, Yumi was one of the biggest{nl}actresses in the entertainment industry.

Talk_Detention_Yumi_Intro.name: Mareka
Talk_Detention_Yumi_Intro.text: {sprite:Desi["Smiling"]}{blip:2}She loved spreading rumors and ruining people.{nl}That was her specialty.

Talk_Detention_Yumi_Intro.name: Mareka
Talk_Detention_Yumi_Intro.text: Even I've been troubled by false rumors about me recently...

Talk_Detention_Yumi_Intro.name: Mareka
Talk_Detention_Yumi_Intro.text: {blip:2}About my relationships, about Yusaku,{nl}about money... everything, really.

Talk_Detention_Yumi_Intro.name: Mareka
Talk_Detention_Yumi_Intro.text: {sprite:Desi["Thinking"]}And things just got worse from there.{nl}She started selling the rumors to magazines.

Talk_Detention_Yumi_Intro.name: Mareka
Talk_Detention_Yumi_Intro.text: I was facing the crisis of having to retire{nl}from the entertainment industry.

Talk_Detention_Yumi_Intro.name: Mareka
Talk_Detention_Yumi_Intro.text: But actually, the person Yumi hurt the most{nl}was probably the stage manager, Usaki.

Talk_Detention_Yumi_Intro.name: Mareka
Talk_Detention_Yumi_Intro.text: She'd say things like 'When I see that disgusting man,{nl}I feel like I'm going to throw up,'{nl}and she was really harsh to him.

Talk_Detention_Yumi_Intro.name: Mareka
Talk_Detention_Yumi_Intro.text: He said he couldn't bear the humiliation{nl}and that he resented her.

Talk_Detention_Yumi_Intro.name: Phoenix
Talk_Detention_Yumi_Intro.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(The victim had other people who resented her.{nl}There could be other suspects besides the accused){color:white}{setState:talked_detention_yumi,true}{jump:Talk_Detention_Check}{sectionEnd}

Talk_Detention_Yumi_Repeat.name: Mareka
Talk_Detention_Yumi_Repeat.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Desi["Normal"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{blip:2}Yumi was an amazing person.{nl}But not everyone liked her.{sectionEnd}

Talk_Detention_Outfit_Intro.name: Phoenix
Talk_Detention_Outfit_Intro.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Desi["Normal"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{blip:1,false}You were in that outfit during rehearsal?

Talk_Detention_Outfit_Intro.name: Mareka
Talk_Detention_Outfit_Intro.text: {blip:2}No. During rehearsal I wore the stage costume.{nl}Yusaku brought me this one, so I changed into it.

Talk_Detention_Outfit_Intro.name: Mareka
Talk_Detention_Outfit_Intro.text: {sprite:Desi["Smiling"]}{blip:2}I could never wear something like this around Yumi.{nl}I had to be very careful about what I wore every day.

Talk_Detention_Outfit_Intro.name: Mareka
Talk_Detention_Outfit_Intro.text: {sprite:Desi["Thinking"]}{blip:2}Yumi hated the color red.{nl}From our first meeting, she instructed me not to wear anything with red in it.

Talk_Detention_Outfit_Intro.name: Phoenix
Talk_Detention_Outfit_Intro.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(The victim disliked the color red...{nl}The colors of clothing and props might be significant){color:white}{setState:talked_detention_outfit,true}{jump:Talk_Detention_Check}{sectionEnd}

Talk_Detention_Outfit_Repeat.name: Mareka
Talk_Detention_Outfit_Repeat.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Desi["Thinking"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{blip:2}I had to be careful not to wear red every day.{sectionEnd}

Detention_Center_Complete.name: Mareka
Detention_Center_Complete.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Desi["Sweating"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{blip:2}I'm telling you again, I didn't do it.{nl}I'm counting on you for tomorrow's trial.

Detention_Center_Complete.name: Phoenix
Detention_Center_Complete.text: We'll secure a not guilty verdict no matter what.

Detention_Center_Complete.name: Phoenix
Detention_Center_Complete.text: {blip:0,false}For Yusaku's sake too,{nl}I'll bring you good news.

Detention_Center_Complete.name: Phoenix
Detention_Center_Complete.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(Once we have all the information, we'll head to court.{nl}That's where we'll make everything clear!){color:white}{setState:detention_center_done,true}{setAction:talk,false}{playSound:jingle}{jump:Demo_Ending}{sectionEnd}

Demo_Ending.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Desi["SmilingWide"]}{p:1000}{fadeOutBg:1000}{p:1000}{hideCharacter}{bg:GameOver}{fadeInBg:1000}{p:1000}{showTextbox}{center}Investigation on this device has concluded.{nl}Please hand over to the next person.{sectionEnd}
